title: Pennant Software: m and a review (fictional)

documents.title: Vendor due diligence summary
documents.text:
Vendor due diligence summary: Pennant Software (fictional, authored test material).
Pennant Software had run-rate EBITDA of €44.9m in FY2024 (reported basis), first issue. For Pennant Nordic, a subsidiary, pension deficit in FY2025 was €39.5m (reported basis). Cost synergies at Pennant GmbH stood at €27.9m in FY2024 (reported basis). Pennant Software had employees of 1651 in FY2024.

documents.title: Management presentation
documents.text:
Management presentation: Pennant Software (fictional, authored test material).
Pennant Software had run-rate EBITDA of €57.4m in FY2024 (reported basis), second issue (corrects the first issue). For Pennant Software, pension deficit in FY2025 was €51.5m (reported basis). Headline purchase price at Pennant Software stood at €801.2m with effect from 1 Jan 2025 (reported basis). Pennant Software had order backlog of €175.2m in FY2025 (reported basis).
